title: Grand Circle Island Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: During this Oahu sightseeing tour, you will be swept away to the island’s most breathtaking landmarks and destinations. Each driver brings first-hand knowledge of each site combined with passion, professionalism, and a dash of fun. Join us on the best tour of Oahu. We guarantee this will be one of the highlights of your trip to Hawaii!
